newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU to attach conditions to Deutsche Telekom plan.
newsitem.headline: EU to attach conditions to Deutsche Telekom plan.

text.p: The European Commission is expected to attach further conditions to Deutsche Telekom's price discount plan, EU sources said on Thursday, but the plan will go ahead as expected on Nov 1.

Asked whether Deutsche Telekom could start its pricing discounts on Friday despite competitors' complaints about the plan, the sources said the Commission would be attaching several conditions relating to the effective opening of the German telecoms market that would be retroactive to Nov 1.

The sources said this would require regulatory changes in Germany regarding in particular access to Deutsche Telekom's infrastructure network such as "break-in and break-out access conditions" to the infrastructure and business networks in particular.
"The decision is about attaching conditions that will have a retroactive effect to Nov 1...(the German government) will have to do it before the end of the year," one source said.
The Commission's competition and legal departments were still discussing the conditions, which could be announced either later today or the beginning of next week.
The Commission earlier this year allowed Deutsche Telekom to iomplement its tariff discounts to big companies on the express condition that effective competition was in place by Nov 1.
